*
 * It iterates through each message in the store, and writes the ones we
 * want to keep into a new mbox file. It'll also patch X-Mozilla-* headers
 * as it goes, if asked to.
 * If all goes well, the old mbox file is replaced by the
 * new one. If any error occurs, the mbox is left untouched.
 * Doesn't fiddle with folder or database or GUI. Just the mbox file.
 * Any higher level database/folder changes are handled by the caller.
 *
 * The commit strategy works like this:
 * 1) create a ".compact-temp" dir in the same directory as the mbox.
 * 2) compact the mbox file into "foo/.temp-compact/inbox.compacting"
 * 3) when successfully completed, rename to
 *   "foo/.temp-compact/inbox.compacted"
 * 4) rename "foo/inbox" to "foo/.temp-compact/inbox.original"
 * 5) invoke OnCompactionComplete() callback to tell the caller to commit
 *    any higher-level changes they need to make in sync with the new
 *    mbox (e.g. database changes).
 * 6) rename "foo/.temp-compact/inbox.compacted" to "foo/inbox".
 * 7) all done!
 *
 * If anything goes wrong at any stage, the old mbox will be restored to
 * the state it started in.

*
   * If any callbacks return an error, the whole operation will be rolled back
   * and .onFinalSummary() will be called with the failure code.
   *

   * .onCompactionComplete() callback has been invoked.

text: MboxCompactor.h says any error leaves the mbox untouched and uses .temp-compact in its walkthrough. Current path setup uses .compact-temp, and a failed final install can leave the original moved aside for recovery. The IDL still says the listener is released after onCompactionComplete even though the implementation must call onFinalSummary afterward and the higher-level comments now name that final boundary. Scoped documentation recommendation: update these statements to the actual phase, path and recovery limits; do not replace them with an unverified universal rollback guarantee. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Compaction documentation must preserve late-failure and listener-lifetime limits
